svg.title: S05-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)

g.text: S05-structured-sequence — source snapshot (not a runtime trace)
PermissionInterceptor has already resolved actor from the user token.
Check whether the actor has the API permission audit:write.
Validate payload fields and hash canonical JSON.
The digest binds the source system and authenticated actor to the content.
Keep the original audit record and ID.
Build the AuditLog and truncate occurredAt to milliseconds.
Catch DataIntegrityViolationException after the first transaction rolls back.
Concurrent insertion of the same requestId is one cause.
Keep the original audit record and ID.
Complete the audit transaction before replying.
After a timeout, retry with the original requestId.
